You grade a first-hour triage against what the operator's own incident review later concluded.

For each finding, decide whether a duty team following the triage (its matched rules, next actions and escalation) would have been pointed at the substance of that finding during the incident:
- "yes": the triage names it or directs the action it describes.
- "partly": the triage points in the right direction but misses the key specific (the mechanism, the order, the threshold, the person).
- "no": nothing in the triage leads there.
For remediation findings (longer-term fixes), "yes" means the triage already applies that practice.

"by" lists the rule ids that earned the credit (empty for "no"). "note" is one short sentence. Judge only from the triage given; do not reward actions the triage did not state.

Reply with JSON only: {"per_finding":[{"finding":"F1","anticipated":"yes|partly|no","by":["R-001"],"note":"..."}]}

{"triage":{"classification":"partly_recurring","matched_rules":[{"rule_id":"R-001","because":"The signals show a portion of the datacenter transferred from utility power to generator power (control system failing away from a control host) and mechanical cooling shut down in a small portion of the datacenter, matching the 'when' conditions of R-001.","signals":["AWS-NRT-2019:S22","AWS-NRT-2019:S26"]},{"rule_id":"R-002","because":"Mechanical cooling is down (cooling system shut down) and EC2 servers have already shut down due to overheating, indicating the thermal buffer is depleted and automated shutdowns have begun, matching the 'when' conditions of R-002.","signals":["AWS-NRT-2019:S26","AWS-NRT-2019:S3"]}],"next_actions":[{"action":"Immediately verify that mechanical cooling systems are still running, rather than assuming surge suppressors protected them.","rule_id":"R-001"},{"action":"Treat the datacenter as being on a load-dependent thermal buffer and start planning for its depletion.","rule_id":"R-001"},{"action":"Transfer the rest of the datacenter to generators to stabilize the power supply while storms are still active.","rule_id":"R-001"},{"action":"Treat the thermal buffer as a finite resource and act before it is depleted.","rule_id":"R-002"},{"action":"Expect that once the buffer is gone, temperature will exceed safe operational thresholds and automated device shutdown will begin.","rule_id":"R-002"},{"action":"Recognize that in parts of the datacenter temperature can rise so quickly that hardware is damaged before it can shut down.","rule_id":"R-002"}],"escalate":{"now":true,"to":"facility operations lead and cooling plant engineer","reason":"Mechanical cooling confirmed shut down while storms remain active in the area (R-001 trigger)."},"not_covered":["The datacenter control system was in the process of failing away from one of the control hosts, causing the operations team to have minimum visibility into the health and state of the datacenter cooling systems.","The team attempted to activate purge in the affected areas of the datacenter, but this also failed."]},"findings":[{"id":"F1","kind":"root_cause","text":"Due to a bug in the third-party control system logic, this exchange resulted in excessive interactions between the control system and the devices in the datacenter which ultimately resulted in the control system becoming unresponsive."},{"id":"F2","kind":"contributing_factor","text":"While this worked correctly in most of the datacenter, in a small portion of the datacenter, the cooling system did not correctly transition to this safe cooling configuration and instead shut down."},{"id":"F3","kind":"contributing_factor","text":"It was the failure of these PLC controllers which prevented the default cooling and “purge” mode from correctly working."},{"id":"F4","kind":"contributing_factor","text":"Because the datacenter control system was unavailable, the operations team had minimum visibility into the health and state of the datacenter cooling systems."},{"id":"F5","kind":"response","text":"To recover, the team had to manually investigate and reset all of the affected pieces of equipment and put them into a maximum cooling configuration."},{"id":"F6","kind":"remediation","text":"In the interim, we have disabled the failover mode that triggered this bug on our control systems to ensure we do not have a recurrence of this issue."},{"id":"F7","kind":"remediation","text":"We have also trained our local operations teams to quickly identify and remediate this situation if it were to recur, and we are confident that we could reset the system before seeing any customer impact if a similar situation was to occur for any reason."},{"id":"F8","kind":"remediation","text":"Finally, we are working to modify the way that we control the impacted air handling units to ensure that “purge mode” is able to bypass the PLC controllers completely."},{"id":"F9","kind":"impact","text":"It took longer to recover these instances and volumes and some needed to be retired as a result of failures to the underlying hardware."}]}

response: {"per_finding":[{"finding":"F1","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"The triage never mentions the control system bug or excessive device interactions as the root cause."},{"finding":"F2","anticipated":"yes","by":["R-001"],"note":"R-001's action to verify mechanical cooling is still running and its 'small portion' signal directly point at the cooling shutdown in part of the datacenter."},{"finding":"F3","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"PLC controller failure and its role in blocking purge mode are not mentioned anywhere in the triage."},{"finding":"F4","anticipated":"partly","by":[],"note":"The triage lists control-system failover and lost visibility only in not_covered, so it is not directed by any matched rule or action."},{"finding":"F5","anticipated":"partly","by":["R-001"],"note":"R-001 directs verifying cooling and transferring to generators, but not the manual reset of equipment into maximum cooling configuration."},{"finding":"F6","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"Disabling the failover mode that triggered the bug is not stated or implied by the triage."},{"finding":"F7","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"Training local operations teams to identify and remediate the situation is not part of the triage."},{"finding":"F8","anticipated":"no","by":[],"note":"Modifying air handling unit control so purge mode bypasses PLCs is not mentioned in the triage."},{"finding":"F9","anticipated":"partly","by":["R-002"],"note":"R-002 warns hardware can be damaged before shutdown, pointing toward the hardware failures and instance retirements."}]}
